hero.text: Fresh roasted beans, homemade pastries and a warm place to sit down and relax.

about.label: Our Story
about.title: A Small Cafe With a Big Heart
about.text: We started with one coffee machine and a love for good conversation. Today we roast our beans every week and bake fresh every morning, so every cup and every plate tastes like home.
about.imageAlt: Cafe interior with wooden tables and warm lights

home.ctaText: Planning a visit with friends or family? Reserve a table and we will have it ready for you.

contactPage.title: Contact Us
contactPage.intro: Have a question, an idea or a booking for a big group? Send us a message and we will get back to you soon.
contactPage.successText: We have received your message and will reply to your email within one or two days.

reservationPage.title: Reserve a Table
reservationPage.intro: Tell us when you are coming and how many people will join. We will confirm your booking by phone.
sideNotes: Tables are held for 15 minutes after your booking time.
For groups of more than 10, please call us directly.
You can cancel or change your booking by phone.
reservationPage.successText: We will call you to confirm your table shortly.
